_comment: Copy to summareader-mcp.local.json and fill in. That name is gitignored.
_token: From a paired device: POST /enroll on the sync server, or `summareader-sync first-device` for the first one. Revocable.
_master_key: The 32-byte library key, base64 — the same value the pairing QR carries. NOT revocable: anything holding this can read everything, for as long as it holds it.
_name: What this device is called in the app's paired-devices list. Sent once at startup. Without it the server shows whatever label the device that minted the token typed — in practice "A new device".
name: MCP mirror
_bearer_token: Required to call the MCP HTTP port. Without it the port is open to anyone who can reach it and serves the whole library in plaintext; the server warns at startup. Any long random string: openssl rand -base64 32. Called http_token before; that spelling is still read.
_host: What `serve --transport=http` binds, and the address the console's Address chooser writes back here. Loopback by default, which is one machine talking to itself; a wider address serves the whole library in plaintext and is refused without a bearer_token. A container wants 0.0.0.0 — its boundary is the published port.
_port: The port that address is bound on. --host and --port on `serve` still win over both this and the environment.
_sync: Whether to pull on a loop at all. Set false for a mirror that holds what it already has and asks for nothing — while a sync server is down, or on a machine that should only read. `pull` on the command line still works, and so does the console's Sync now. Ignored when `library` is set, which never syncs.
_poll_seconds: How often a mirror pulls, when it does. Five minutes by default.
_cache_dir: Where the decrypted library is kept. Defaults to ~/.local/share/summareader-mcp, or ~/Library/Application Support/summareader-mcp on macOS. Still spelled cache_dir, and the variable is still SUMMAREADER_MCP_CACHE, because renaming them would touch both Dockerfiles, both compose files, the unit and every install that exists — but it is the library, not a cache: a mirror runs no retention, so over time it holds more than any of your devices do.
_library: Read this library file directly, read-only, and do not sync at all — the file's spelling of --library, for running on the same machine as the app. With it set, nothing above is needed: no server, no token and no key.
_fetch_bodies: Download each article's text as well as its summary, so search covers what the articles say rather than only their titles. A server can afford the bytes; set false if this one cannot.
